name: 3-found
description: 自用 macOS 桌面应用

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @found/backend" "npm run dev -w @found/frontend" "wait-on tcp:4317 tcp:5173 && npm run dev -w @found/desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @found/backend" "npm run dev -w @found/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @found/backend && npm run build -w @found/frontend && npm run build -w @found/desktop
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run package:mac -w @found/desktop
scripts.check: npm run check -w @found/backend && npm run check -w @found/frontend && npm run check -w @found/desktop
